cards.title: 1. Edge Intake & Hybrid AI Pod
items: Meta Cloud API webhook verified via X-Hub-Signature-256 + Redis WAMID deduplication
Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite primary with 60s circuit breaker prevents 20s WhatsApp timeouts
Pass 1 (Trip JSON) + Pass 2 (Guest Manifest) + Deterministic Math & Fact Gates

cards.title: 2. Tool Calling -> Hono Quotation Studio
items: When 6 core fields are complete, AI calls submit_quotation_to_hono (<35ms compute)
Staff edits itemized table (Room, Split-Day Dives, Meals, 30% Partner Discount) at /quotes
Generates custom shareable customer quotation link (/q/sky-oct10-group)

cards.title: 3. Hono Confirm -> Odoo GAIS & Guest Reply
items: Clicking Confirm triggers POST /v1/quotes/:id/confirm and synthesizes verified AI reply
Signs outbound Odoo payload with X-GAIS-Signature (HMAC-SHA256) + Idempotency-Key
Upserts clean Odoo sale.order without polluting ERP with unverified chat drafts
